title: The whole suite's darwin wall time is bounded by two module scopes, test_land_e2e.py and test_backlog_portable.py, each 22 to 29 s of serial tests on one worker
goal: With the slowest tests of ST-k3e4q43i cut, a whole-suite darwin run is bounded by the module scope of _tools/test_land_e2e.py (about 29 s of serial tests: stage_back 12.5 s, empty_selection 8.6 s and three more) and of _tools/test_backlog_portable.py (about 24 s): python3 _tools/perfcheck.py time --max-seconds 20 _tools/test_land_e2e.py _tools/test_backlog_portable.py exits 0 with every assertion kept (a scope split into classes of its own, as the land e2e's classes are, or a scenario's repeated clone and commit work cut), and _tools/tests_ceiling.json is not raised. Measured on 2026-10-14: a whole-suite run without ST-k3e4q43i's cuts took 29.3 s against the 29 s ceiling and with them 29.6 s, the same two scopes the longest.
